annotations.title: Assess an IBAN, BIC, US routing number, SA branch code, SADC mobile money or address before you send

description: Structural check on a payment destination: an IBAN's own checksum (ISO 7064 MOD 97-10), a US ABA routing number's own checksum, a BIC's format (ISO 9362), an EVM address's EIP-55 checksum, a South African universal branch code recognised against known major banks, or a SADC mobile-money number (South Africa, Zimbabwe, Malawi, Zambia) assessed for the right country code and length. Catches a mistyped or mis-keyed identifier, the single most common cause of a misdirected payment. A payment platform is several rails at once (SEPA, Fedwire/ACH, stablecoin); this assessments whichever identifiers you supply. UK sort codes and most domestic account numbers carry no public checksum and are not covered. This is NOT confirmation of payee or verification of payee: it does not confirm the name on the account, only that the identifier is internally consistent (or, for a branch code or phone number, plausible). Paid: configure this server with an Authorization Bearer key (https://swapeazi.io/pricing).

address.description: An EVM address, '0x' followed by 40 hex characters.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the mobile-money number: ZA, ZW, MW or ZM.

mxClabe.description: A Mexican CLABE (SPEI account), 18 digits; its verification digit is verified.

saBranchCode.description: A South African universal branch code, 6 digits.

usRoutingNumber.description: A US ABA routing number, 9 digits.
